name: minicrm
//engines: DECLARATIVE, not enforced. npm honours engines only under engine-strict, and no .npmrc sets it — deliberately: 82 packages in the tree declare node >= 22 and would turn every npm ci into a hard failure. CI pins the real floor via .nvmrc + setup-node. (MINCRM-704)
//packageManager: Also declarative — nothing here enables Corepack. Records the npm that ships with the node version .nvmrc pins (node:24-alpine -> npm 11.17.0), which is what CI actually runs. (MINCRM-704)

scripts.unit_test: npm test --workspace=minicrm-server && npm test --workspace=minicrm-client && npm test --workspace=minicrm-coverage-dashboard
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=minicrm-server && npm run typecheck --workspace=minicrm-client && npm run typecheck --workspace=minicrm-qa && npm run typecheck --workspace=minicrm-coverage-dashboard && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run format:check

//overrides.basic-ftp: Crosses get-uri's declared ^5.3.1 because no 5.x fixes GHSA-c475-qrg2-pj4r; npm ls marks it invalid. Safe because get-uri imports only Client, and 6.0.0's sole break is refusing a separate FTP transfer host by default. Retire once get-uri declares ^6. See docs/dev/dependencies.md.
//overrides.undici: Knowingly violates @connectrpc/connect-node's ^5.28.4; npm ls marks it invalid. Safe only because its sole undici use is a globalThis.Headers polyfill gated on node major < 18, dead at this repo's Node 24 floor — recheck if connect-node starts using undici for real. Also violates @ai-sdk/provider-utils' ^6.28.0, safe because it uses only Agent connect.lookup and fetch, both unchanged in 7.x. Held on 7.x because promptfoo declares >=7.30.1 <8, a range 8.x would break. See docs/dev/dependencies.md.
//overrides.@azure/identity: Pins @azure/msal-node past the ^6.0.0 @azure/identity declares, because no 6.x fixes GHSA-xcx6-jx8p-x3h5; npm ls marks it invalid. Safe because 7.0.0's sole break removes responseMode from acquireTokenInteractive, which @azure/identity never passes (msal-node CHANGELOG.md). Dev only, via promptfoo. Retire once @azure/identity declares ^7. See docs/dev/dependencies.md.
